headline: Franklin built an approval-gated research handoff that keeps outreach and CRM writes under human control.

what_changed.summary: Added a source-backed lead packet validator and importer for pending review.
Added explicit approval-decision audit records before draft preparation.

why_it_matters: This gives Agentic-Hub a practical pattern for AI-assisted research without granting agents authority to send outreach, update CRM records, or use signed-in browser sessions.

evidence.reference: dbe9acfd57 Add Agentic-Hub pending review importer
PASS records approval with outbound actions still prohibited

public_safe_case_study: For Agentic-Hub, Franklin created a lightweight contract where research outputs are validated, imported into pending review, and only moved forward after a named human decision. The implementation demonstrates practical AI workflow automation with auditability and clear limits instead of claiming full autonomy.
risk_notes: No private client data is disclosed.
No email, DM, CRM write, or signed-in browser action is automated.
next_actions: Capture a screenshot of the pending-review queue.
Turn this proof packet into a concise portfolio update.
